# Vulcx

> Vulcx is a swap aggregator for SVM (Solana Virtual Machine) chains, providing best-price
> multi-hop routing across every DEX on a supported chain. Live on Fogo today, routing across
> Valiant, Fluxbeam and Moonit; Solana support is in progress.
> Base URL: `https://api.vulcx.xyz`. Three core endpoints: GET /api/v1/quote, POST /api/v1/swap,
> POST /api/v1/instructions. An API key is OPTIONAL on REST endpoints — anonymous calls work but
> are capped at 1 cost unit/second; a key raises that to the one published budget of 100 cost
> units/second, burst 200, which is the same for every plan. GET /health
> needs no key. The WebSocket stream (GET /api/v1/stream) is the one endpoint where a key is
> required, passed as ?key=vulcx_...

## Get Started

- [Introduction](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/get-started/introduction): Introduction to Vulcx, a swap aggregator for SVM chains, live on Fogo. Covers what Vulcx is, its value props (best-price multi-hop routing, fast execution, simple 3-endpoint API), the endpoint table (GET /api/v1/quote, POST /api/v1/swap, POST /api/v1/instructions, GET /health) with an auth-required column, and quick cURL + TypeScript + Python examples for getting a FOGO→USDC quote on Fogo. Notes that an API key is optional on REST endpoints (quote/swap/instructions/price) — anonymous calls work but are capped at 1 cost unit per second, a key raises that to the single published budget of 100 cost units per second (burst 200), the same for every plan — while the WebSocket stream always requires one; see /get-started/authentication.
- [Authentication](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/get-started/authentication): How to authenticate with the Vulcx API. REST endpoints on https://api.vulcx.xyz (GET /api/v1/quote, POST /api/v1/swap, POST /api/v1/instructions, GET /api/v1/price) accept an OPTIONAL API key (format vulcx_...) sent in the Authorization: Bearer header — calls with no key are allowed but capped at a small anonymous per-IP budget (1 cost unit/second, burst 5); a key raises that to the single published budget of 100 cost units/second, burst 200, which is identical for every plan — plans differ only in how many keys you may hold. GET /health never requires a key. The WebSocket stream (GET /api/v1/stream) is the one endpoint where a key is REQUIRED, passed as ?key=vulcx_... since browsers can't set custom headers on a WS handshake. Covers getting a key (free during beta, requested at https://vulcx.xyz/api-key/), authenticating with cURL/TypeScript/Python, passing the key in the SDK (apiKey), 401/403 errors for invalid keys, key security best practices, and a link to rate limits. SVM chains: live on Fogo today, Solana in progress.
- [Architecture](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/get-started/architecture): High-level architecture of Vulcx on SVM chains (live on Fogo). Covers the data flow (client → API → the SVM network), components (API server, routing engine, on-chain program), supported DEXs (Valiant, Fluxbeam, Moonit bonding curves), and the three integration paths: POST /api/v1/swap for ready-to-sign transactions, POST /api/v1/instructions for custom off-chain transaction composition, and POST /api/v1/cpi/route-accounts for calling the route instruction on-chain from another program via CPI (PDA-signed, atomic).
- [FAQ](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/get-started/faq): Frequently asked questions about Vulcx. Covers supported chains (live on Fogo, Solana support in progress), supported tokens on Fogo (Valiant, Fluxbeam, Moonit), quote freshness, devnet support, transaction size limits, ExactIn vs ExactOut, fee structure, rate limits, multi-hop behavior, and how to monitor API status.

## Docs — Swap

- [Swap Overview](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/docs/swap/overview): Overview of the Vulcx swap lifecycle on SVM chains (live on Fogo): get quote, build transaction or get instructions, sign and submit. Explains when to use POST /swap vs POST /instructions, ExactIn vs ExactOut swap modes, Fogo capabilities (5 max hops, Valiant/Fluxbeam/Moonit DEXs), supported tokens, and links to detailed pages for each step.
- [Get Quote](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/docs/swap/get-quote): Detailed guide for GET /api/v1/quote on SVM chains (live on Fogo). Covers all parameters (inputMint, outputMint, amount, swapMode, slippageBps), complete response schema (QuoteResponse with RouteInfo array, price impact fields, otherAmountThreshold, firm-quote quoteId/validForMs/firmForMs), cURL, TypeScript, and Python examples, and price impact severity guidance.
- [Firm Quotes](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/docs/swap/firm-quotes): Guide to Vulcx firm quotes on SVM chains (live on Fogo). Every GET /api/v1/quote response and WebSocket quote push carries a quoteId (with validForMs and firmForMs). Passing quoteId to POST /swap or POST /instructions replays the exact quoted route with min-out anchored to the quoted price (route pinning, Tier 1, default ~3s window). Adding firm: true within firmForMs (~400ms) collapses slippage to the server's firm margin (default 10 bps) around the quoted price — price-or-fail: if the price drifted past the margin the API returns 409 before any transaction is built. Quotes are also Ed25519-signed (quoteSignature, quoteExpiresAtMs) over the canonical message vulcx-quote-v1|quoteId|inputMint|outputMint|amountIn|amountOut|exactIn|expiresAtUnixMs; the verification key is served unauthenticated at GET /.well-known/vulcx-quote-signer, so partners can prove offline what price was committed. Error contract: 410 quote expired, 409 route gone or drifted, 403 quoteId from another key, 400 request mismatch. The WebSocket stream pushes {type:invalidate, quoteId} when a quote drifts past the firm margin. Includes cURL/TypeScript examples and retry guidance.
- [Build Transaction](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/docs/swap/build-transaction): Detailed guide for POST /api/v1/swap on SVM chains (live on Fogo). Covers request body (userWallet, inputMint, outputMint, amount, swapMode, slippageBps, skipSimulation, plus optional quoteId to replay the exact quoted route at the quoted price and firm for price-or-fail redemption inside the firm window), complete response schema (SwapHandlerResponse with base64 transaction, lastValidBlockHeight, SimulationResult), simulation error handling, and cURL + TypeScript + Python examples.
- [Get Instructions](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/docs/swap/get-instructions): Detailed guide for POST /api/v1/instructions on SVM chains (live on Fogo). Explains when to use instructions instead of swap (custom transaction composition, adding memos, creating accounts). Covers request body (including optional quoteId and firm for firm-quote redemption, referrer for the on-chain referral fee share, and sessionAccount for Fogo Sessions — session-shaped single route instruction, no ATA-create/wrap instructions, requiredTokenAccounts in the response, Valiant-V1-only), response schema (InstructionsResponse with RawInstruction array, addressLookupTableAddresses, requiredTokenAccounts), and complete TypeScript example for building a v0 transaction from raw instructions with Address Lookup Tables.
- [Stream Quotes](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/docs/swap/stream-quotes): Guide to the Vulcx WebSocket quote stream (wss://api.vulcx.xyz/api/v1/stream) on SVM chains (live on Fogo). Requires an API key as a ?key=vulcx_... query parameter — the stream is the one endpoint where a key is mandatory; REST endpoints (quote/swap/instructions/price) accept an optional key instead. Explains when to stream vs poll GET /api/v1/quote, how to connect, the subscribe/unsubscribe protocol with a pairs array ({in, out, amount, exactIn}), how to handle quote, invalidate (firm-quote drift), and ack messages, that every quote push carries a firm-quote quoteId/validForMs/firmForMs redeemable on POST /swap, reconnection, and limits (256 subscriptions/connection, change-only pushes, ~50ms debounce). Includes runnable Browser and Node.js (ws) examples with the key in the connection URL.
- [Send Transaction](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/docs/swap/send-transaction): How to sign, submit, and confirm an Vulcx swap transaction on SVM chains (live on Fogo). Covers deserializing the base64 transaction from POST /api/v1/swap, signing with @solana/web3.js VersionedTransaction, sendRawTransaction, confirmTransaction with lastValidBlockHeight, transaction expiry handling, retry strategy, preflight checks, and confirmation levels (processed, confirmed, finalized). Includes TypeScript and Python examples.

## Docs — Concepts

- [Supported chains](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/concepts/chains): Vulcx is a swap aggregator for SVM chains — live on Fogo, Solana in progress. Covers Fogo capabilities: max hops per route (5), supported DEXs (Valiant, Fluxbeam, Moonit), token standard (SPL Token), and a quote example.
- [Routing](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/concepts/routing): How Vulcx routing works at a high level on SVM chains (live on Fogo). Covers direct swaps, multi-hop routing through intermediate tokens (up to 5 hops), supported liquidity sources (Valiant, Fluxbeam, Moonit bonding curves), price impact severity levels, and slippage protection mechanics.
- [Fees](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/concepts/fees): Vulcx fee structure on SVM chains (live on Fogo). Three separate costs: (1) DEX pool fees set by pool operators (Valiant, Fluxbeam, Moonit), reported as feeBps in the quote response and feeAmount in swap/instructions responses; (2) Vulcx's protocol fee, reported as platformFeeBps and platformFeeAmount, taken from the output amount, set by the global on-chain protocol config or lowered by a per-integrator PartnerConfig override; (3) the integrator's own fee, set per request as integratorFeeBps and kept 100% by the integrator, paid on-chain to the referrer wallet and reported as integratorFeeAmount. platformFeeBps and integratorFeeBps are INDEPENDENT and ADD — integratorFeeBps is not a share of the protocol fee. Their sum is capped at 100 bps (1%); exceeding it returns HTTP 400. Setting integratorFeeBps requires a referrer wallet to pay it to. Both rates stand down together when the protocol fee is disabled on-chain. amountIn and amountOut already account for every cost.
- [Security](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/concepts/security): Vulcx security model on SVM chains (live on Fogo). Covers non-custodial design (API returns unsigned transactions, user's wallet signs and submits directly), atomic execution (multi-hop reverts if any hop fails), slippage protection (on-chain enforcement via slippageBps), and open-source verification of on-chain program instructions.

## SDK

- [SDK quickstart](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/sdk/quickstart): Quickstart for the @vulcx/sdk TypeScript SDK. Covers npm install, initializing VulcxSDK, calling sdk.quote() for a FOGO to USDC quote on SVM chains, building an unsigned transaction with sdk.swap(), and signing/submitting with @solana/web3.js VersionedTransaction. SVM chains: live on Fogo today, Solana in progress.
- [SDK configuration](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/sdk/configuration): Configuration reference for the Vulcx TypeScript SDK. Documents the SDKConfig object passed to the VulcxSDK constructor: apiKey, baseUrl, and retry behavior (retries, backoff). Includes a self-hosted API base URL override.
- [sdk.quote()](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/sdk/quote): Reference for sdk.quote() in the Vulcx TypeScript SDK. Documents QuoteRequest params (inputMint, outputMint, amount in smallest units, swapMode ExactIn/ExactOut, slippageBps default 50) and QuoteResponse fields (amountIn, amountOut, priceImpactBps, priceImpactPercent, priceImpactSeverity none/low/moderate/high/extreme, feeBps, otherAmountThreshold, routes RouteInfo array). Includes a token-decimals table (FOGO 9, USDC 6, FISH 6) and error cases. SVM chains: live on Fogo today, Solana in progress.
- [sdk.swap()](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/sdk/swap): Reference for sdk.swap() in the Vulcx TypeScript SDK. Documents SwapRequest params and SwapResponse (base64 transaction, lastValidBlockHeight, amountIn/amountOut, SimulationResult). Shows signing and submitting with @solana/web3.js VersionedTransaction and with a React wallet adapter. SVM chains: live on Fogo today, Solana in progress.
- [sdk.instructions()](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/sdk/instructions): Reference for sdk.instructions() in the Vulcx TypeScript SDK. Returns InstructionsResponse (RawInstruction array, RawAccountMeta, addressLookupTableAddresses) for composing custom transactions when you need memos/tips, account creation, or batched swaps. Includes a full example building a v0 VersionedTransaction with Address Lookup Tables, plus guidance on instructions() vs swap().
- [SDK error handling](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/sdk/error-handling): Error handling for the Vulcx TypeScript SDK. All errors extend VulcxError. Documents typed subclasses by HTTP status: BadRequestError (400), AuthError (401/403), NoRouteError (404), RateLimitError (429), ServerError (5xx), with fields and when each is thrown. Covers automatic retry/backoff behavior and a catch-all pattern.
- [SDK types reference](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/sdk/types): TypeScript types exported from @vulcx/sdk. Unions: SwapMode (ExactIn or ExactOut), PriceImpactSeverity (none/low/moderate/high/extreme). Config: SDKConfig. Quote: QuoteRequest, QuoteResponse, RouteInfo. Swap: SwapRequest, SwapResponse, SimulationResult. Plus instruction types.
- [SDK examples](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/sdk/examples): End-to-end Vulcx TypeScript SDK examples for React, Next.js (App Router), Node.js, and browser/CDN, plus an ExactOut-mode example. Each shows initializing VulcxSDK, quoting, building a transaction, and signing/submitting on SVM chains (live on Fogo).

## API Reference — Overview

- [Introduction](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/api-reference/introduction): Vulcx API reference overview. Base URL: https://api.vulcx.xyz. Vulcx is an SVM-chain aggregator: live on Fogo today, Solana support in progress. Covers the JSON response envelope ({success, data, error}), HTTP status codes (200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 429, 500), the auth model (an API key is optional on REST endpoints — GET /api/v1/quote, POST /api/v1/swap, POST /api/v1/instructions, GET /api/v1/price — anonymous requests are allowed but capped at 1 cost unit per second; a key raises that to the single published budget of 100 cost units per second, burst 200, which is the same for every plan; WS /api/v1/stream still requires a key; see /get-started/authentication), and the endpoint table with an auth-required column linking to GET /api/v1/quote, POST /api/v1/swap, POST /api/v1/instructions, WS /api/v1/stream, GET /api/v1/price, and GET /health.
- [Rate Limits](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/api-reference/rate-limits): Vulcx API rate limits on SVM chains (live on Fogo). One published budget applies to every API key regardless of plan: 100 cost units per second sustained, burst 200. Buckets are debited by request cost, not request count — GET /api/v1/quote and GET /api/v1/price cost 1 unit, GET /api/v1/pools and POST /api/v1/cpi/route-accounts cost 3, POST /api/v1/swap and POST /api/v1/instructions cost 5. That is 100 quotes/second, or 20 transaction builds/second, or any mix. Rate limits deliberately do NOT vary by plan; plans differ only in how many keys they allow. Anonymous requests with no Authorization header get 1 unit/second, burst 5. A separate pre-auth per-IP ceiling of 200 units/second, burst 400, runs before authentication and covers the WebSocket upgrade. Covers the 429 response format, exponential backoff retry strategy with cURL, TypeScript, and Python examples, and best practices (do not cache quotes, stream instead of polling, use the instructions endpoint).
- [Error Codes](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/api-reference/errors): Complete Vulcx error reference. Covers HTTP status codes, per-endpoint error messages (quote: invalid inputMint, no route found, insufficient liquidity; swap: invalid user wallet, simulation failed; instructions: missing pool data), SimulationResult fields (insufficientFunds, slippageExceeded), Vulcx aggregator program errors by Anchor code (6006 SlippageExceeded, 6007 InvalidPoolDiscriminator, 6009 MintMismatch, 6008 ExactOutMultiHopNotSupported, 6022 ExactOutUnsupportedSwapType, session errors 6019-6021), and generic Solana runtime / SPL Token errors (expired blockhash, insufficient funds) with recovery actions.

## API Reference — Endpoints

- [Get Quote](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/api-reference/quote): OpenAPI reference for GET /api/v1/quote on the Vulcx API (SVM chains; live on Fogo, Solana in progress). Returns the best route and estimated output for a token pair. Query params: inputMint, outputMint, amount in smallest units, swapMode (ExactIn/ExactOut), slippageBps (default 50). Response includes amountIn, amountOut, priceImpactBps, feeBps, otherAmountThreshold, hopCount, a routes array, and a firm-quote quoteId with validForMs/firmForMs — pass quoteId to POST /swap or POST /instructions to replay this exact route at this price. Interactive playground included.
- [Build Swap](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/api-reference/swap): OpenAPI reference for POST /api/v1/swap on the Vulcx API (SVM chains; live on Fogo, Solana in progress). Builds an unsigned, ready-to-sign swap transaction. Request body: userWallet, inputMint, outputMint, amount, swapMode, slippageBps, skipSimulation, plus optional quoteId (replay the exact quoted route, min-out anchored to the quoted price) and firm (price-or-fail within firmForMs; slippage collapses to the firm margin). Firm-quote errors: 410 quote expired, 409 route gone or price drifted past margin, 403 quoteId from another key, 400 request mismatch. Response: base64 transaction, lastValidBlockHeight, amountIn/amountOut, and a SimulationResult. Interactive playground included.
- [Get Instructions](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/api-reference/instructions): OpenAPI reference for POST /api/v1/instructions on the Vulcx API (SVM chains; live on Fogo, Solana in progress). Returns raw instructions for custom transaction composition (memos, tips, batching). Accepts optional quoteId (replay the exact quoted route, min-out anchored to the quoted price) and firm (price-or-fail within firmForMs). Firm-quote errors: 410 expired, 409 stale, 403 wrong key, 400 mismatch. Response includes a RawInstruction array with accounts/data and addressLookupTableAddresses for building a v0 VersionedTransaction. Interactive playground included.
- [CPI Route Accounts](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/api-reference/cpi-route-accounts): OpenAPI reference for POST /api/v1/cpi/route-accounts on the Vulcx API (SVM chains; live on Fogo, Solana in progress). Builds the `route` instruction shaped for a Cross-Program Invocation: the request supplies a calling program's PDA as the swap authority (signer, writable when a Moonit hop is involved) instead of a wallet. Response returns a single RouteInstruction (RawInstruction with accounts/data) to forward into the program's route CPI and sign with invoke_signed, plus requiredTokenAccounts (ATAs the PDA must own and fund — no ATA-create or wrap/unwrap instructions are emitted) and addressLookupTableAddresses for a v0 transaction. Split routes are not yet supported (422). Beta. Interactive playground included.
- [Stream Quotes](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/api-reference/stream): Protocol reference for the Vulcx WebSocket quote stream at wss://api.vulcx.xyz/api/v1/stream on SVM chains (live on Fogo). Requires an API key as a ?key=vulcx_... query parameter (not a header — browsers can't set custom headers on a WS handshake); connecting without one fails the handshake. Raw JSON-over-WebSocket (not socket.io). Clients send subscribe/unsubscribe ops with a pairs array ({in, out, amount, exactIn}); the server replies with an immediate first quote, an ack ({type:subscribed|unsubscribed|error, count}), and thereafter pushes a quote message ({type:quote, in, out, amount, amountOut, priceImpactBps, hops, slot, quoteId, validForMs, firmForMs}) only when the quote materially changes. Each push carries a firm-quote quoteId redeemable on POST /swap or POST /instructions; a {type:invalidate, quoteId} push means the last quote drifted past the firm margin. Limits: 256 subscriptions per connection, change-only pushes, ~50ms debounce.
- [Get Price](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/api-reference/price): Reference for GET /api/v1/price on the Vulcx API (SVM chains; live on Fogo, Solana in progress). An API key (Authorization: Bearer) is optional — anonymous calls work but are capped at 1 cost unit/second; send a key for the one published budget of 100 cost units/second, burst 200, identical for every plan. Returns the spot/mid USD price for a token mint, derived from live on-chain pool state (not an external feed). Anchored on stablecoins = $1 and the native FOGO token priced from the deepest native↔stable pool; every other token is priced from its deepest anchor-paired pool. Single lookup GET /api/v1/price/:mint and batch GET /api/v1/price?mints=a,b,c (max 100). Response fields: mint, price, slot, updatedAt. price is 0 when unknown (no anchor-paired pool yet, or decimals pending). This is a spot oracle distinct from GET /api/v1/quote, which is size- and slippage-aware.
- [Health Check](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/api-reference/health): OpenAPI reference for GET /health on the Vulcx API. Lightweight service health check returning service status. No authentication required. Use for uptime monitoring.

## Guides

- [Executing Swaps](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/guides/executing-swaps): Step-by-step guide to executing a token swap on Vulcx on SVM chains (live on Fogo). Covers the full flow: GET /api/v1/quote (with cURL + TypeScript + Python), POST /api/v1/swap to build the transaction, then sign with @solana/web3.js VersionedTransaction, sendRawTransaction, and confirmTransaction. Includes complete runnable code examples.
- [On-Chain Swaps (CPI)](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/guides/onchain-cpi): Guide to composing Vulcx swaps on-chain via Cross-Program Invocation (CPI) on SVM chains (live on Fogo). Another Solana program calls the Vulcx aggregator's `route` instruction with invoke_signed, using its own PDA as the swap authority instead of a user wallet — so a best-price multi-hop swap becomes an atomic step inside a lending liquidation, vault rebalance, pay-with-any-token flow, perps collateral conversion, DAO treasury swap, or zap. Covers: when to use CPI vs POST /swap vs POST /instructions; the off-chain step POST /api/v1/cpi/route-accounts (cURL/TypeScript/Python) which returns routeInstruction + requiredTokenAccounts + referrerAta + addressLookupTableAddresses; route corridors (allowedIntermediateMints max 16, maxHops, excludeDexes vortex/fluxbeam/moonit — constrained requests bypass caches, never split, 404 if no route inside constraints; excluding moonit lifts the authority-writable requirement); per-request integrator fee (integratorFeeBps is the caller's own rate, kept 100% by them and paid on-chain to the referrer wallet; it ADDS to Vulcx's platformFeeBps rather than being a share of it, sum capped at 100 bps, referrerAta must pre-exist); the on-chain step in Rust/Anchor using the vulcx-cpi crate (RouteAccounts, RouteArgs, Hop, VortexHop, invoke_route_signed; `api` feature adds ParsedRoute::from_api_response which parses the endpoint JSON into typed builders and fails on layout drift; crate major version tracks the deployed program's instruction layout) with a full worked minimal integrator instruction and #[derive(Accounts)] context; the exact route account layout (6 fixed accounts + per-hop account groups for Vortex 7, Vortex V2 10, Fluxbeam 14, Moonit 14, with writable/signer flags); WebSocket subscribe_route streaming route templates (op subscribe_route, {type:route, seq, slot, route} pushed only when the template — route plan/accounts/LUTs — changes, max 32 per connection, for zero-HTTP-round-trip liquidation keepers); and gotchas (ATAs must be pre-created and funded, no wrap/unwrap emitted, simulate:false for real execution — simulate:true skips the min-out check, Moonit hops make the authority writable, split routes unsupported (422), multi-hop ExactOut returns 400 — use the ExactIn-with-buffer pattern). Includes the liquidation kit worked example (Anchor liquidate ix + TypeScript keeper). Beta feature.
- [Handling Errors](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/guides/handling-errors): Error handling guide for the Vulcx API on SVM chains (live on Fogo). Covers the error response format, common HTTP errors (400, 404, 429, 500) with causes and fixes, simulation error fields (insufficientFunds, slippageExceeded), on-chain transaction errors (SlippageExceeded, BlockhashExpired), and retry strategy with cURL, TypeScript, and Python examples for each error category.
- [Embedding Swap in a dApp](https://docs.vulcx.xyz/guides/embedding-swap): Complete guide to embedding Vulcx swap in a React web app on SVM chains (live on Fogo). Includes TypeScript functions for getQuote and buildSwapTransaction (both sending the required Authorization: Bearer API key header), an executeSwap function using @solana/wallet-adapter-react signTransaction, a full React SwapButton component example, error handling table for UI messages, and best practices (show price impact, refresh quotes, handle rate limits).

## AI

Covers llms.txt (LLM-optimized site index for discovering relevant pages), skill.md (decision-tree playbook for AI agents to route intents to the correct API endpoints), and how to use these resources for automated swap integration.
